title: For finite loop-free quivers with nonzero framing and a stability face with both zero and positive coordinates, IC pushforward to zero stability has regular-stratum multiplicities equal to highest-weight Levi branching
author: Hiraku Nakajima
source_version: Official SIGMA 5 (2009) article 003, DOI 10.3842/SIGMA.2009.003; journal PDF and native TeX acquired 2026-10-01, exact bytes pinned by SHA256
difficulty_reason: The usual quiver-variety representation theorem does not identify which intersection-cohomology summands appear after an intermediate stability face is contracted to zero stability. The author compares the two semismall convolution algebras and their decomposition-theorem multiplicity spaces, then uses the face-stratum direct-sum diagram to exclude nonregular supports from the relevant branching coefficients. This geometric comparison turns restriction to the Levi algebra into a precise regular-stratum IC multiplicity formula.

proof_review.note: Read positive chamber/face construction and Jordan-Hölder stability transport8-10; full local symplectic normal chart12-13 and authored semismall consequence13-14; exact face-stratum and kernel/cokernel decomposition14-15 plus direct-sum finite diagram(2.29)15; complete convolution/decomposition/multiplicity formalism22-24, explicit Levi Hecke embedding24 and entire Theorem5.6 proof24-25. Select its regular-stratum multiplicity conclusion only, for a finite loop-free graph over C, nonzero framing w, positive generic chamber zeta and a face zeta_bullet with zero coordinates I0 and strictly positive remaining coordinates, restricting I0 to nonempty proper. Precisely cited Nakajima prior irreducible top-fiber representation and Chriss-Ginzburg/BBD semismall decomposition are established foundations, not omitted new cores. The source gives explicit direct-sum morphisms kappa/kappa0 and states their finiteness as the routine affine quiver-quotient property; no collector verification or new finite-map argument added. Nonregular IC summands are explicitly unspecified in the author statement and not reconstructed here. No affine-Levi Theorem5.15, categorical Satake strengthening, MV-cycle or crystal helper count. SourceTheorem4.1 is explicitly attributed as previously obtained by Malkin and is supporting context only.

original_metadata.statement_scope: The regular-stratum coefficient part of Theorem5.6. Work over C with a finite graph without edge loops, associated symmetric Kac-Moody algebra g, nonzero dominant framing w, generic positive stability zeta and zeta_bullet on the source Section2.8 face, zero on a nonempty proper I0 and positive elsewhere. For pi_(0,zeta_bullet), the multiplicity space of each regular-stratum IC(M_0^s(v_prime,w)) in the pushforward of IC(M_zeta_bullet^s(v,w)) is the Hom space of the corresponding irreducible integrable highest-weight modules under restriction to g_I0+h, with the exact weights in the original displayed Theorem5.6. IC complexes use the original perverse dimension shifts and closures. Other nonregular supports remain unspecified; no full IC decomposition or arbitrary stability face is claimed.
